open_points.subject: try an implementation
open_points.text: “try an implementation | agent | trial evidence per case” does not say which trial cases one request executes
open_points.question: Does one try request execute the implementation against the whole current corpus, one named case, or a caller-selected set of cases?
options: Run every case in the contract version’s current corpus
Run one case named by the caller
Run a caller-selected set of existing cases
open_points.default_guess: Run every case in the contract version’s current corpus.

open_points.subject: agent inspection and repair context
open_points.text: “inspect functions” is available to every agent, while K-12 says “For repair an agent receives one contract, its current implementation and that slot's recent traces and trial evidence; for composition, contracts, bindings and not implementation bodies”; no repair action or inspection mode is defined
open_points.question: Which product action selects the repair slot and exposes its implementation and evidence, and does ordinary function inspection expose implementation bodies or evidence outside that one-slot repair context?
options: Inspect has an explicit repair context selecting one slot; only that context exposes its current implementation and evidence
Every agent may inspect all implementation bodies and evidence; K-12 only describes a preferred presentation
Implementation bodies and evidence are unavailable through inspect and are returned through a separate repair action
open_points.default_guess: Treat inspect as having a one-slot repair context; ordinary composition inspection exposes contracts and bindings but no implementation bodies.

open_points.subject: ProofResult
open_points.text: M17 says “proving the same version gives the same result,” but the carried decision says a version whose proof failed because a binding was not accepted “can be proven again later” after that same binding changes from `proposed` to `accepted`
open_points.question: When mutable binding status changes the answer for the same flow version, is each ProofResult a snapshot identified by its result and proof-time dependencies, is one mutable result associated with the version, or is the result required to remain fixed?
options: Each computation yields an immutable snapshot value whose identity includes the result and relevant proof-time dependency state
One mutable ProofResult belongs to the flow version and changes when dependencies change
ProofResult is fixed by flow_version_id and later binding acceptance cannot change it
open_points.default_guess: Each computation yields an immutable snapshot value whose identity includes the result and relevant proof-time dependency state.
